faqs.a:
(a)
The city manager, or a designee thereof, shall grant an exemption to the enforcement
               of subsection
38-282
(a) hereof to any person who relies on a solid fuel burning device as a sole source
               of heat; provided, however, such solid fuel burning device was installed in the building
               prior to November 1, 1987. As a condition of granting an exemption, any person applying
               for an exemption shall be required to sign an affidavit stating reliance on a solid
               fuel burning device installed prior to November 1, 1987, as the sole source of heat.
               An exemption granted by the city manager shall be effective for one year from the
               date it is granted.
(b)
There shall be an exemption from enforcement of this article for heating or cooking
               by a solid fuel burning device in the event of the interruption of either a heating
               or cooking source to a building.
(c)
There shall be an exemption from enforcement of this article, as well as enforcement
               of any burning restrictions contained in the International Building or Residential
               Code and the International Mechanical Code as they are adopted and amended from time-to-time,
               for any areas above 7,000 feet.
(d)
There shall be an exemption from enforcement of this article for any exemptions contained
               in the International Building or Residential Code and the International Mechanical
               Code as adopted and amended from time-to-time.
(e)
The requirements in subsection
38-282
(c) relating to newly installed new or used solid fuel burning factory-built fireplaces
               or to new masonry fireplaces shall not apply upon issuance by the city of the fireplace
               exemption permit. Any fireplace for which there is issued a fireplace exemption permit
               shall conform to all other applicable provisions and regulations, including installation
               terms and listings of the manufacturer as specified in the Mechanical Code, of
chapter 18
. The fee for issuance by the city of a fireplace exemption permit shall be $500.00.
               Each fireplace shall require a separate exemption permit.
(Code 1981, § 21-78; Ord. No. 2451, § 1, 10-19-1987; Ord. No. 2868, § 10, 1-20-1992)
